extra.reason: Column sort is now category -> parked -> name in both clients. Parked = status name starting with blocked/on hold/waiting/paused/impediment, so Blocked lands after In Progress. 5 new BoardColumnOrderTests cover it; 12/12 native tests pass, tsc and eslint clean.
